name: ELO_145PTO_PTOSwitch_2Channel_AMPSuperseal
description: Power Take-Off Switch 145PTO, contactless reed pushbutton with E-stop function, AMP Superseal 1.5 282105-1 3-pin connector, angled (145PTO010B00).
notes: Despite the 'E-stop function' marketing name, elobau's datasheet asserts no functional-safety rating (no SIL/PL/ASIL claim) for this reed-switch product; do not treat as a certified safety component without independent assessment. Ordering-key product table (page 2) lists this part as '48V/0.3A/10W/VA' but the detailed article-characteristics table (page 3, same datasheet) specifies 36V DC / 0.5A / 10W / 10VA — this file defaults to the article-characteristics values as the more detailed source; verify against the exact order confirmation before production use. The circuit diagram shows ONE shared 3.9 ohm series resistor (between common pin 1 and the RS1/RS2 branch node), not two discrete per-channel resistors. RS1 and RS2 are not functionally labeled in the datasheet beyond their reed-switch tags (e.g. push-engage vs push-disengage/E-stop position) — verify actual position mapping before production use.

connectors.name: X1
connectors.mounting: M30x1 threaded body, SW36 nut, AMP Superseal 1.5 angled connector

signals.name: ELO_145PTO_RET
signals.description: Common return for RS1/RS2, in series with the shared 3.9 ohm sense resistor (connector pin 1).

signals.name: ELO_145PTO_RS1
signals.description: Reed switch channel RS1 (connector pin 2); exact mechanical position/state not labeled in datasheet circuit diagram.

signals.name: ELO_145PTO_RS2
signals.description: Reed switch channel RS2 (connector pin 3); exact mechanical position/state not labeled in datasheet circuit diagram.

source_metadata.rating_discrepancy: Ordering-key product table (page 2) states 48V/0.3A/10W/VA; article-characteristics table (page 3) states 36V DC max switching voltage, 0.5A max switching current, 10W/10VA max switching power. This file uses the article-characteristics values.

Verify exact ordering-key suffix before production use.
